North Carolina Oyster Festival
date: Saturday, October 17: 9:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m.  ||  Sunday, October 18: 10:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
location: 1 East 2nd St., Ocean Isle Beach, NC 28469
description: Check out the popular annual North Carolina Oyster Festival at neighboring Ocean Isle Beach, which dates back to 1978! Enjoy a variety of foods, crafts, contests, and musical performances at the Ocean Isle Beach Town Center Park. The Festival’s signature Oyster Shucking Contest is always held on Saturday. Bring a chair to sit back and enjoy live music featuring a variety of genres. Dancing is encouraged!

title: North Carolina Festival by the Sea at Holden Beach
date: Saturday 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (followed by live music) & Sunday 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM
location: Holden Beach Pavilion and Fishing Pier
description: Hosted by the Holden Beach Merchants Association, the annual NC Festival by the Sea is a free weekend-long event on Holden Beach. The Festival by the Sea takes place the last full weekend of October and is slated this year for October 24-25, 2026.

title: Yoga at Bridgeview Park
description: The Town of Holden Beach offers beginner friendly yoga classes on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays at 9:00 a.m. at the picnic shelter at Bridgeview Park. The class is taught by Alice Ledford. Fee is $6 for residents and $8 for non-residents.

title: Sunset Beach Market at the Park
description: The 2026 Sunset Beach Summer Market season is scheduled weekly on Thursdays from April 30th through September 24th from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. The market vendors consist of jewelry, pottery, local honey, baked goods, soaps, candles, photography, woodcrafts, and much more. Come out and enjoy the open-air shopping while taking in the beautiful views from Sunset Beach Town Park.

title: U.S. Open King Mackerel Tournament
description: The U.S. Open King Mackeral Tournament enters its 47th year in 2026 and highlights the best of fall fishing in the Southport/Oak Island area. The tournament attracts over 400 boats of all sizes and is an exciting, family-friendly event during this time of year. The weekend-long festivities begin with food catered from Wallace Catering Food Truck and Clem's Seafood, with entertainment provided by Almost Blue on Thursday and Hood's Creek on Saturday. For a full schedule of events , visit the tournament's website.

title: Bald Head Island Guided Historic Tours
description: Bald Head Island historical golf cart tours takes you across the island while discussing four centuries of Bald Head Island’s history. Themes include piracy, colonization, the U.S. Lighthouse Service, U.S. Life-Saving Service, and development of Bald Head into an island resort. Tours are Tuesdays, Fridays and Saturdays from March - December.

title: U.S. Open King Mackerel Tournament
date: October 1st-3rd 2026 Where: 4433 Long Beach Road, SE Southport, NC Website
location: When: October 1st-3rd 2026  4433 Long Beach Road, SE Southport, NC Website
description: Holy mackarel! The U.S. Open King Mackerel Tournament, held at Dutchman Creek Park in Oak Island, NC, attracts over 400 boats of all sizes annually. The event showcases the great fall fishing in the Southport-Oak Island area with prizes, food, and entertainment.

title: North Carolina Oyster Festival
date: October 17th-18th, 2026 Where: Town Ctr Pk, 11 E 2nd St, Ocean Isle Beach, NC Website
location: When: October 17th-18th, 2026  Town Ctr Pk, 11 E 2nd St, Ocean Isle Beach, NC Website
description: The annual North Carolina Oyster Festival featuring Live Bands, Oyster Eating & Shucking Contest, Oyster Stew Cook-off, and Food & Shopping Vendors is held in Ocean Isle Beach, NC. Come celebrate everything Oyster at the Ocean Isle Beach Town Center Park.

title: Lighthouse Beer & Wine Festival
description: Come together to celebrate some of our favorite beverages: beer & wine!

title: Festival by the Sea at Holden Beach
date: October 24th - October 25th, 2026 Where: 0 Jordan Blvd , Holden Beach, NC Website
location: When: October 24th - October 25th, 2026  0 Jordan Blvd , Holden Beach, NC Website
description: Join us for the Festival by the Sea, Holden Beach's annual arts & crafts extravaganza! Enjoy a parade, fishing tournament, live music, street dance, horseshoe tournament, sandcastle building contest, and so much more. Plus, it's the only time of the year you can walk across the beautiful Holden Beach bridge!
